item.title: About
item.description:
Hey, I’m Nicholas! Here I document my journey with technology and share my projects and experiences. You’ll find mostly honest accounts of what I’ve learned by trying things and seeing what sticks. I generally learn things the hard way and jump into projects before fully understanding them, but hey, it makes for a good story! If that interests you feel free to check out some of my projects!
